title: The Tower Tarot Card Meaning in the Thoth Deck
subtitle: Why card XVI is a moment of clarity, not a curse: Peh, Mars and the path between Netzach and Hod.
seo_title: The Tower Tarot Card Meaning in the Thoth Deck
seo_description: The Tower tarot card meaning in the Thoth Tarot: Peh, Mars, path 27 and how to read the card upright, ill-dignified and inside a spread.
cover_alt: A stone tower on a cliff struck by golden lightning under a violet night sky

faq.question: Is The Tower a bad card in tarot?
faq.answer: No. It shows something unstable coming down. It is uncomfortable, but it clears the ground for something that holds.

faq.question: Does the Thoth Tarot have reversed cards?
faq.answer: No. Thoth readings use dignities instead: the same card read well or ill according to the cards around it.

faq.question: Which Hebrew letter belongs to The Tower?
faq.answer: Peh, on path 27 of the Tree of Life, between Netzach and Hod, with the planet Mars.
